table().title: Names the grid. The /trading chart does not show the title.
table().rows: The number of rows. Rows are addressed from 0, so a grid of 4 rows has rows 0 to 3.
table().cols: The number of columns, addressed from 0 like the rows.
table().position: The corner of the pane the grid is pinned to: `"topLeft"`, `"topRight"`, `"bottomLeft"` or `"bottomRight"`. An `input()` with the four corners as options lets the reader move it.
table().textColor: The text colour of every cell that sets none of its own.
table().bgColor: The grid's background, behind every cell that sets none of its own. A translucent colour such as `fade(black, 25)` keeps the candles behind the grid faintly visible.
table().borderWidth: The thickness of the grid's border, with `0` for no border.

cell().t: The table to write into: the value `table()` returned.
cell().row: The row to write, counting from 0. A row outside the grid is error `OS4004`, which stops the script on that bar.
cell().col: The column to write, counting from 0. A column outside the grid is error `OS4004`.
cell().text: The text to show. Convert a number with `text()` first; a text that is `none` leaves the cell blank.
cell().textColor: The text colour of this cell, overriding the grid's `textColor`.
cell().bgColor: The background of this cell, overriding the grid's `bgColor`.
cell().align: Where the text sits in the cell: `"left"`, `"center"` or `"right"`. Put labels left and numbers right so the digits line up.
